description: Diagnose a Verbaly project end to end (what `verbaly doctor` does). It checks the config file, the catalogs and their JSON, the bundler plugin for the detected framework, the generated types, files the parser could not read, a t imported from a package that never exports it, orphan keys, and every failure `verbaly check` would report, and it reports them all at once instead of stopping at the first. Run it first when something does not work. Read-only. For the missing or broken translations themselves, use verbaly_missing.

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

name: verbaly_doctor

fix.description: What to run or change, when there is one

ok.description: False when an entry is an error, which is when the CLI exits 1
